data.narrative:
Kodiak AI operates in the Defense & Security sector at the public stage, having raised $250M+ to date. The valuation universe consists of 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Evolv Technology, and Castelion.

The peer-median method is not applicable to this analysis. The Defense & Security sector contains 26 same-sector peers overall, but application of stage-specific, adjacent-stage, and valuation-tier filters yields fewer than three datapoints in any narrow category. Relying on an all-sector median would introduce excessive methodological noise and obscure sector-specific dynamics. The sparse, heterogeneous comp set—combining early-stage private companies with established public names—prevents reliable triangulation via direct multiple application.

This analysis therefore cannot support a specific valuation range without additional data on: (1) Kodiak's current revenue, EBITDA, or growth rates; (2) multiples or recent valuation rounds from the named private peers; (3) current market prices and fundamentals for the two public comparables. The frontier-defense segment's nascent revenue bases, long sales cycles, and customer concentration further complicate standardized valuation approaches. A credible range would require either expansion of the comp set to adjacent sectors (aerospace, intelligence software) or reliance on transaction precedents and forward revenue forecasts specific to Kodiak's contract pipeline.
